title: Hat Pack 1 - First Accessory Collection
summary: 5 hats at 3 sizes = 15 transparent PNG overlays. First accessory pack for the Corner character system.
content:
Hat Pack 1 - First Accessory Collection

5 hats x 3 sizes = 15 transparent PNG overlays.

Hats

Hat 128px 48px 24px Style
Party Hat party-hat-128.png party-hat-48.png party-hat-24.png Colorful cone, pom-pom, stripes
Hard Hat hard-hat-128.png hard-hat-48.png hard-hat-24.png Yellow dome, safety stripe, brim
Crown crown-128.png crown-48.png crown-24.png Gold peaks, red/blue/green jewels
Santa Hat santa-hat-128.png santa-hat-48.png santa-hat-24.png Red with white fur trim, pom-pom
Chef Hat chef-hat-128.png chef-hat-48.png chef-hat-24.png White toque, pleated puff, band

Design Rules

  1. Transparent overlays. All hats are PNG with alpha. They sit ON TOP of the character sprite.
  2. Position: top-center of head. The hat's bottom edge aligns with the top of the character's hair.
  3. Must not obscure primary props. Bobby's headphones + party hat = the hat sits above the headphones, not covering them. Mom's headset + hat = headset ear pieces stay visible.
  4. Scale with character size. Use the matching size (128px hat on 128px character, 48px on 48px, 24px on 24px).
  5. One hat at a time. Characters wear one hat max. No stacking.

Bobby Integration

Loading

function getAccessorySprite(accessoryId, size) {
  return `/assets/characters/crossy-road/accessories/${accessoryId}-${size}.png`;
}

Compositing

// Render character first, then overlay accessory
<div className="character-with-accessory" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
  <img src={getCharacterSprite(agentId, state)} />
  {equipped.hat && (
    <img
      src={getAccessorySprite(equipped.hat, characterSize)}
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '-15%',  // Sits above head
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      }}
    />
  )}
</div>

Conflict Resolution

  • If agent has headphones (Bobby): shift hat up 4px extra
  • If agent has headset (Mom): shift hat up 2px extra
  • If agent has glasses (Steve, Steffen): no conflict, hat sits above glasses
  • If agent has ring light (Tony): hat renders ABOVE the ring light glow

Unlock System (Future)

Hats can be:

  • Default unlocked (party hat is free for all agents)
  • Achievement unlocked (crown when agent completes 50 tasks)
  • Seasonal (santa hat December only, chef hat for restaurant vertical clients)
  • Purchased from marketplace

Render Script

scripts/render-accessories.js
